components.description: Six weeks (225 hours) of paid leave at 100% of base pay for an eligible faculty or staff member (12 months' service) after the birth or adoption of a child, taken within 12 months of the event; concurrent with FMLA and the Tennessee leave statutes.

components.eligible_parent_wording: "biological parent(s) or adoptive parent(s)"; "Surrogate mothers and sperm donors are not eligible"
components.duration_note: "up to six (6) weeks (225 hours)"; prorated by FTE; intermittent or reduced-schedule use needs supervisor approval; unused leave is forfeited 12 months after the birth or adoption.
components.pay_fraction: 100 percent of the employee’s base pay rate
components.relief_note: a paid leave of absence; no relief stated (R9). The department may receive replacement funds to cover courses and essential duties.
components.service_requirement: continuously employed in a regular position for at least 12 months prior to the birth or adoption
components.time_window: within twelve (12) months following the birth or adoption of a child; births or adoptions on or after December 1, 2017
components.use_limit_note: "limited to receiving the Paid Parental Leave benefit up to three times during their career at the University, regardless of any breaks in service"; multiple births at the same time do not increase the leave.
components.dual_employee_rule: each parent may receive up to six (6) weeks (225 hours)
components.notice: Paid Parental Leave Request Form to HR at least three (3) months before the leave, or as soon as practicable; birth or adoption documentation within 30 days
components.return_obligation: reimburse salary paid if the employee does not return or leaves within 90 days, unless employed 5 or more years or the failure is due to a medical condition of the employee or child

Birth parent chain: Paid Parental Leave 6 weeks (c1), with FMLA 12 workweeks (c5) and the Tennessee 4-month leave (c6) concurrent from its start; c1 lies within the negotiated modified-duties relief that runs to the end of the semester in which the six weeks end (c2); own sick leave (c8) within FMLA, then the sick leave bank (c9) after own balances; any general leave without pay (c10) after FMLA.

Non-birth parent chain: Paid Parental Leave 6 weeks (c1) with FMLA 12 workweeks (c5) concurrent from its start; c1 within the negotiated modified-duties relief to the end of that semester (c2); own sick leave (paternity use) within FMLA (c8). The Tennessee 4-month leave is coded for birth and adoptive parents only (ambiguous for a non-birth parent).
